title: Operator Task Binding State v1
description: Request to pause or resume one local binding under a current operator binding. Pausing is reversible and needs no reactivation; revocation stays a P085 operation. The host verifies the operator binding and the expected revision when it commits the change. A request whose outcome already holds changes and records nothing. A pause that must not depend on a current operator binding uses `operator-task-binding-emergency-pause.v1` instead; this request never falls back to it.

local-binding/expected-digest.description: The `local-binding/digest` of the revision this change was prepared against, as readiness or a profile-change review reported it. The host compares it with the stored binding when it commits the change and refuses a mismatch with `local-binding/revision-stale`.
